name: NerfAcc Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) with Coarse/Fine Sampling and NDC
definition: A standalone PyTorch library providing efficient sampling for volumetric rendering, decoupled from radiance field representation, supporting Occupancy Grid and Proposal Network.
summary: The NerfAcc Rendering Pipeline is a modular PyTorch library that accelerates neural volume rendering by decoupling sampling from radiance fields using efficient transmittance estimators to skip empty space.
